summary: Scenario EN01 started: The grid runs dry

scenario.name: The grid runs dry
scenario.description: Automatic recharge is switched off (UTILITY auto_recharge_off); the city keeps consuming and the reserve drains, then the operator recharges (UTILITY recharge_all).
scenario.trigger: python scenarios/run.py EN01   (or the Run button on the control center; --server to play it on the running Brain, live or mock)

expected.twin: GRID-01 reserve falls with the real load, then refills.
expected.brain: 25 %: dims every street light; 15 %: sheds the largest zone that may be cut (never a hospital zone); recharged: restores the zone and the lights.
